skill.displayName: AI Hot Bikini Models – Generate Realistic Bikini Models Online – API-powered
skill.summary: Hot bikini models — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
hot-bikini-models-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Transforms a person photo into a bikini model image or video using the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports input photo upload, optional scene descriptions, and choice of video or image output.
- Requires a WeShop API key with secure usage instructions.
- Includes endpoint documentation for starting a run, polling status, and uploading images.
